sourceChecks.text: The sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bore Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBの本文と前後の系譜・名簿を照合した。

profileDecisionJa: アブラハムの側室ケトラが産んだ子らの一人として、ジムラン、ヨクシャンらとともに名が挙がります。

wikipediaReadEvidence.title: Shuah
wikipediaReadEvidence.locator: “Genesis 25” section, lines 113–120: set-index introduction distinguishes several Hebrew names sharing the KJV transliteration; this section identifies Shuah as a son of Abraham and Keturah and reference 4 cites 1 Chronicles 1:32.
wikipediaReadEvidence.supportJa: The article separates several names transliterated “Shuah” and its Genesis 25 entry identifies Abraham and Keturah’s son, with a citation to 1 Chronicles 1:32. This supports the genealogical figure in this verse; other Shuah-named figures on the same page are distinct.
